<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Oh, hello. Can I help you?
What’s that? You want to make an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1469)>?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>I see... Well, you were correct in assuming that I know the
answers to all the small mysteries of the world.
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)>But I’ve been asleep so long, I can’t seem to shake the fog
from my head.
<$voicel(4,1)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,663)>It may take some time before I remember all the things I
used to know.

...<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,20)><$motionoff(4,804)>Or rather, that’s certainly how it feels, but for some
reason, how to make an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1469)> is one
thing I DO remember clear as day.
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,801)>Are you listening now? Here’s what you’ll need to do...

...<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,20)><$motionoff(4,804)>Or rather, that’s certainly how it feels, but for some
reason, how to make an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1469)> is one
thing I DO remember clear as day.
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,801)>Are you listening now? Here’s what you’ll need to do...
You learned a <$cdef(27)>recipe </color>for an <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1469)></color>!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>If you connect <$cdef(27)>two <$ifull(1469)> with a ladder,
<$voicel(4,6)>the <$cdef(27)>elevator will start moving.

<$voicel(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,14)>Actually, it’s not limited to just <$cdef(27)>two. As long as they’re
connected by <$cdef(27)>ladders with no gaps...
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)><$motionoff(4,804)>You can line up <$cdef(27)>three or even <$cdef(27)>four <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1469)>
and they still should work properly.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>For some reason, all my knowledge about <$cdef(27)>elevators—and
only about <$cdef(27)>elevators—has come rushing back to me.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,50)>I’d love to see that knowledge put to good use. Would you
please build <$cdef(27)>one actual <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1469)> for me?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,50)>I’d love to see you put my instructions into practice and
make <$cdef(27)>one <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1469)>.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,49)>You may need to source your materials from
another island.

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,5)><$motionoff(4,804)>It seems you’ve successfully built an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1469)>.
I’m pleased to learn my memory didn’t fail me.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Now all that remains is for you to set it up properly.

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,803)>If you connect <$cdef(27)>two <$ifull(1469)> with a <$cdef(27)>ladder,
<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)>the <$cdef(27)>elevator will start moving.

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,27)>Dang, I can’t believe you seriously fixed up that <$cdef(27)>elevator.
You’re somethin’ else, pal!

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>All right, whaddya say we hop in this <$cdef(27)>elevator and ride it
up to the top?

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,4)>You lead the way, since ya did most of the heavy liftin’. I’ll
be right behind ya. <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)>Now take me up that <$cdef(27)>elevator!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>Lead me to that <$cdef(27)>elevator</color> and let’s head up to the top!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,816)>Dang, that was so easy! <$cdef(27)>Elevators </color>RULE!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>The dojo’s over this way. You should check it out since
you’re here, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Well? Whaddya think of the dojo? Kinda run-down, but
it’s got a nice vibe, right?
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,38)>Not gonna lie, this is my favorite place to be.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,806)>Now I’ve seen what you’re capable of, I wanna ask for your
help with one more thing.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>I don’t have a place to live now, y’see. So I was wonderin’
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>if you could make me a home that feels like a dojo.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>I don’t have a place to live now, so I was wonderin’...
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Could ya make me a home that feels like a dojo?

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,805)>Whoa! Thanks for makin’ me such an awesome place to
live, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)>If ya ever need a hand buildin’ up this town, you can count
on me! <$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,8)>Just gimme a call if I can help with anything!
